fields.description: Continue: a repeating cadence with no fixed number of visits (e.g. every 30 days, forever) - one record per High Risk value. Specific: a fixed, numbered list of visits, each with its own day window - one record per program, with every visit listed in the table below.
fields.label: Schedule Type

fields.description: Leave blank for a single record that applies regardless of risk. Set Yes/No to give risk and non-risk patients their own cadence - add one record for each.
fields.label: High Risk

fields.description: The repeat interval, in days - the normal ongoing cadence every patient for this program gets. This keeps running in the background even for a Risk patient; it never changes on its own.
fields.label: Repeat Every (Days)

fields.description: How many repeat cycles to auto-generate/auto-calculate before switching to manual entry.
fields.label: Automatic Window Count

fields.description: How many days into the cycle/window the CHW should be nudged to visit early, once this patient is High Risk - and also the gap used to automatically schedule an urgent re-visit once a visit is completed and found Risk. One shared number for this program, not entered per row.
fields.label: Risk Alert Within (Days)

fields.description: One row per visit, in order - however many rows exist, that's how many visits there are for this program. Each row is fully independent, so any protocol shape (a gap in between, back-to-back weeks, irregular spacing) is just data, no code change needed.
fields.label: Visit Schedule
